A sales representative should handle each request as follows, based on the official sales playbook, security policy, and pricing docs:

- **Immediate deletion:** Do not promise immediate deletion [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. The standard policy is deletion within 90 days after contract termination; data is immediately removed from active access but physical deletion takes up to 90 days [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. For Enterprise clients, a custom DPA exception can be negotiated — e.g., 30-day active purge and 60-day backup purge — but it must be documented in the DPA, not verbally [NL-019#NL-019-S05]. Route any custom deletion request through Priya Raman and formal legal review [NL-009#NL-009-S08].

- **Teams availability:** Do not guarantee a launch date or present the integration as "almost ready" [NL-009#NL-009-S08][NL-027#NL-027-S04]. The roadmap shows the Microsoft Teams integration is in planning/design for Q4 2026 [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Do not offer insecure alpha builds or one-off custom containers [NL-027#NL-027-S04]. Frame the timing as a target, and offer the responsive mobile web interface with TutorChat as a workaround [NL-027#NL-027-S04].

- **Custom pricing:** Do not offer custom discounts on Starter or Growth plans; all discounts must be approved by Marcus Reed and align with the current pricing sheet [NL-009#NL-009-S08]. Enterprise pricing starts at $8,500/month plus a $15,000 implementation fee, but final enterprise pricing should not be quoted on discovery calls [NL-009#NL-009-S08][NL-023#NL-023-S07]. Use only the 2026 pricing schedule; any $900/month Starter references are deprecated [NL-004#NL-004-S05][NL-004#NL-004-S05].
